# <span id="aanchor213"></span> Master Characteristics

Accessing this screen requires the **Master Characteristics** module and **System Process – Master Data** privileges.

Master Characteristics define how a meter’s characteristics should look when brought in from the field and are typically created based on the last meter test report.

Like Meter Characteristics, Master Characteristics are datetime effective. Master Characteristics can be set up to create exceptions if there is a difference between the meter’s master characteristic and the meter characteristic. You can also have the master characteristic updated automatically to reflect the meter characteristic in the field. Both exception creation and automatic master characteristic updates can be toggled on or off for each field in Master Characteristics. You can also validate the imported analysis to look for differences in the imported analysis.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Master Characteristics screen:

Go to **Setup** \> **Meter** \> **Master Characteristics**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 613;height: 418;" />

</div>

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Master Characteristics Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Master Characteristics screen:

- **Navigation Buttons** - Click the following when a list is selected:

> - 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> **Back to Beginning** - Navigate to the first meter number in the list.
> - 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> **Back One** - Move back in the list to the previous meter.
> - 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> **Launch Tree View** - Open the Tree View for the list selected.
> - 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> **Forward One** - Move forward in the list to the next meter.
> - 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> **Forward to End** - Navigate to the last meter number in the list.

- **Effective From/Effective To** - The dates for which the master characteristic data is effective. The grid is filtered based on these dates.
- **All Dates** - Sets the Effective From date to the start of time and the Effective To date to the end of time.
- **Refresh** - Refreshes the grid.
- **New** - Create a new Master Characteristics record.
- **Edit** - Edit an existing master characteristic record.
- **Delete** - Delete an existing master characteristic record.
- **Exit** - Exit Master Characteristics and return to main screen.

</div>

## <span id="Tabs"></span>Screen Tabs

Three tabs are available within the Master Characteristics screen:

- [Analysis Tab](Master%20Characteristics%20-%20Analysis%20Tab.md)
- [Contractual/Operational Tabs](Master%20Characteristics%20-%20Contractual-Operational%20Tabs.md)
